title: Usher and Chris Brown's Epic Tour: Surprise Guests and a Stage Kick!
summary:
Have you ever been to a concert where the singers bring out surprise guests? That's what's happening on Usher and Chris Brown's big R&B tour! These two superstars have been filling stadiums all summer, singing and dancing their hearts out. And they've had some awesome surprises.

At different shows, they've brought out famous rappers and singers like Future, 50 Cent, and Mary J. Blige. Imagine being in the crowd and suddenly 50 Cent appears to rap "In Da Club"! That would be wild.

But one of the most talked-about moments wasn't a guest—it was when Usher kicked a woman off stage. During a show in Nashville, Usher was doing his famous lap dance move, but the woman he picked from the audience looked bored and uninterested. Usher wasn't having it, so he told her to leave the stage. The video went viral! Some people thought it was funny, others thought it was rude. What do you think?

Usher says this tour is like a dream come true. He compared teaming up with Chris Brown to Michael Jackson and Prince going on tour together. "Imagine if Michael and Prince were able to do something together," he said. That's a big compliment!

The tour is so popular that they just added eight more shows, making 59 total. They're going to cities like Baltimore, Cincinnati, and Indianapolis. So if you love R&B, dancing, and surprise guests, maybe you'll get to see them live!
why_it_matters: This story shows how a live moment can be seen very differently by different people—some laugh, some feel it was rude—and how music stars build excitement around shared experiences.
